scope: Metadata and local-file inventory only; no external expression acquired, read, trained on, or scored.
external_data_rule: Task 1 external public data are permitted with license and disclosure. Measured external data after E9.5 through E13.5 inclusive are excluded; E10.5 and E12.5 targets are excluded absolutely. A mixed-stage resource requires protected cells removed before training and removal described. External E9.5 exactly is permitted, but an E8.5-to-E9.5 development backtest must train only through E8.5.

metadata_only_candidate.tissue: embryonic cardiac cells, not the challenge heart-centred dissection
metadata_only_candidate.assay: single-cell RNA sequencing; platform and normalization require compatibility review

stage_policy.E9.5: potentially eligible for final E10.5 model, not E8.5-to-E9.5 backtest training
stage_policy.E10.5: prohibited; must be excluded before expression access

metadata_only_candidate.raw_supplementary_tar: mixed-stage 425.5 MB; do not download or read unscreened
metadata_only_candidate.stage_specific_manifest: GSE76118_STAGE_METADATA_MANIFEST.json: GEO MINiML metadata-only screen, 143 E8.5 and 1288 E9.5 candidate GSM IDs; 1536 E10.5 and 274 embryoid-body samples excluded; training not approved
metadata_only_candidate.prospective_value: Uncertain; limited cell count and tissue/assay mismatch may make this a lineage diagnostic rather than a robust model-training source.

next_gate: Sample-level metadata allowlist is built and excludes E10.5; next verify source license, assay normalization, genotype/region relevance, and the 143/1288 raw-versus-118/949 analyzed-cell QC discrepancy before deciding whether D-only, individual-GSM early-stage expression acquisition is justified. Never download mixed-stage RAW.tar. E9.5 cannot train the E8.5-to-E9.5 backtest. Preserve source disclosure. No temporal-validation claim until separate eligible measured data are obtained and held out.
